params.prompt:
Single continuous shot, locked-off tripod camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts.

Lume, the furry mascot seated at the podcast table, speaks one Hebrew sentence to his co-host off-screen to the right, with exaggerated comic indignation. His speech is exactly the reference audio and his lips are synced to it: he starts speaking at 0.6 seconds and finishes at 2.8 seconds, saying: "קניתי בגללו ארבע מאות קילו תותים".

Performance: he delivers the line with wide eyes and eyebrows that jump up and then furrow, leaning a little toward the co-host. One paw lifts only slightly off the table, staying low and well below his chin with the back of the paw toward the camera, and taps back down on the words "ארבע מאות". His head stays at the same height in the frame: only slight tilts and one small outraged shake, no nodding or dipping. After the last word he shuts his mouth and holds a huffy, offended stare. Head and paw movement stay small and restrained; the face does the acting.

He stays exactly on-model as in the first frame: same fur, ears, eyes, eyebrows, nose, whiskers, two small upper front teeth, hair tuft and tail. The microphone, chair, table, shelves, plants and lighting stay completely still and unchanged.

Audio: only his voice from the reference audio. No music, no sound effects, no other voices.
